summary: @or-sdk/bot-templates preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-shaped payload (string-array rotator `WV8StW` over the array `n7gIxM`, hex-named identifiers, `@bun-cjs` header) that is executed under the freshly-fetched Bun runtime at install time on every consumer. The package's advertised purpose is a bot-templates SDK; there is no legitimate reason to ship an alternate JS runtime and hand it an opaque, heavily obfuscated bundle during `npm install`. Executing the payload under a sibling Bun binary also bypasses any Node-level install-time inspection or hardening on the consumer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
